summary: Build the engines and data schemas that make Taloa a constitutional learning institution.

phases.title: Data schemas and canonical person model

steps.title: Create canonical Human Constellation service
steps.task: Implement the canonical person model graph service. It must support nodes (value, goal, need, belief, pattern, state, trigger, resource, risk, avoidance) and weighted edges with strength, stability, recency, frequency, causal_confidence, and source. Exports: createConstellation(personId), addObservation(constellation, nodeType, payload), weightEdge(constellation, fromId, toId, update), projectForProduct(constellation, productId).
steps.acceptance: Module loads, exports all functions, and a smoke test creates a constellation, adds observations, and projects a LifeOS view.

steps.title: Create Reality Alignment Engine
steps.task: Implement the Reality Alignment Engine. Inputs: RealityPackage with observed, experienced, remembered, predicted, shared fields and a Claim. Outputs: alignment score (0-1), drift report, and reconciliation. Exports: computeRealityAlignment(package, claim), explainDrift(package), promoteConfidence(package, claim, outcome).
steps.acceptance: Smoke test returns alignment score, drift report, and confidence promotion for a sample package.

steps.title: Create Confidence Vector Model
steps.task: Implement the Confidence Vector Model with two dimensions: epistemic confidence and constitutional commitment. Exports: scoreConfidence(evidence), promoteEvidenceTier(evidence, currentTier), and TIER_PROMOTION_CRITERIA.
steps.acceptance: Smoke test promotes an observation to inference and a principle to law based on evidence.

steps.title: Create Causality Engine
steps.task: Implement the Causality Engine. Inputs: event stream and Human Constellation subgraph. Outputs: causal graph with confidence and ranked least-invasive interventions. Exports: estimateCauses(eventStream, constellation), proposeInterventions(targetState, constraints), scoreCausalModel(model, outcomes).
steps.acceptance: Smoke test identifies a likely cause and proposes an intervention from a small event stream.

steps.title: Create Readiness Engine
steps.task: Implement the Readiness Engine. Inputs: target insight and recipient profile. Outputs: readiness score, recommended form (micro-insight, dialogue, exercise, wait), and risk if forced. Exports: assessReadiness(recipient, insight), selectForm(recipient, insight), detectAvoidancePattern(constellation, topic).
steps.acceptance: Smoke test returns a readiness score < 0.5 for an overwhelmed recipient and a safe form.

steps.title: Create Perspective Expansion Engine
steps.task: Implement the Perspective Expansion Engine. Given a Human Constellation and user input, output a summary that captures the user's view in their own frame, identify unstated needs, and ask a better question. Exports: generatePerspectiveSummary(constellation, userInput), identifyUnstatedNeeds(constellation), askBetterQuestion(constellation).
steps.acceptance: Smoke test returns a perspective summary and a question before any recommendation.

steps.title: Create Calibration Ledger service
steps.task: Implement the Calibration Ledger. Stores predictions, outcomes, and calibration scores for offices and models. Exports: recordPrediction(entry), recordOutcome(entryId, outcome), getCalibrationScore(officeId), and getTrustScore(officeId).
steps.acceptance: Smoke test records a prediction, records an outcome, and returns a non-zero calibration score.

steps.title: Create Office Trust Ledger service
steps.task: Implement the Office Trust Ledger. Dimensions: track_record, constitutional_alignment, transparency, independence. Exports: updateTrust(officeId, dimension, delta), getTrustScore(officeId), and TRUST_DIMENSIONS.
steps.acceptance: Smoke test updates a trust score across dimensions and returns an aggregated score.

steps.title: Create Solomon Wisdom Lab service
steps.task: Implement the Solomon Wisdom Lab. It gathers evidence, expands perspectives, compares models, identifies constitutional tensions, and records a recommendation withheld until the Chair independently records a preliminary decision. Exports: createEvidencePackage(topic), addFinding(pkg, finding), addRecommendation(pkg, recommendation, revealAfterChairCommit), getRevelation(pkg, chairPreliminaryDecision).
steps.acceptance: Smoke test withholds recommendation until a chair preliminary decision is recorded, then reveals it.
